diagram_math_checks.evidence: Remarks explicitly retains S=k[x_0,...,x_n]/I, k a field, standard grading and I homogeneous from Definition lines 35–39. U_i=D_+(x_i) is Spec((S_x_i)_0) by part 2; U_ij=Spec((S_x_ix_j)_0) is the common affine overlap by part 3. No reducedness, algebraic closure or projective-space embedding is assumed.

U_ij → U_i comes contravariantly from localizing (S_x_i)_0 at x_j/x_i; U_ij → U_j comes from localizing (S_x_j)_0 at x_i/x_j. Both are open immersions by Definition part 3 and lem-spectrum-localization-open-immersion Statement. Domains and codomains agree with the four drawn nodes.

diagram_math_checks.evidence: U_i → Proj S and U_j → Proj S are the chart open immersions from Definition part 3 and thm-gluing-affine-schemes Statement. Their composites from U_ij agree because gluing identifies these two copies of the same common localization; hence the sole drawn square commutes as scheme morphisms, including structure sheaves.

The prose after the figure identifies U_ijk with D_+(x_ix_jx_k) and explains that the transition identifications restrict canonically from (S_x_ix_jx_k)_0, exactly the cocycle explanation in Definition part 3. No extra arrow/relation is claimed. Repeated indices or empty charts yield identity/empty open inclusions and do not require nonempty overlaps.
